assessment.diversity_evidence: All ten share the premise of Nia wanting a drum duet while Mateo is uneasy about an audience. Most (s000014, s000028, s000023, s000036, s000053, s000048) have Nia perform alone; s000058, s000021, and s000034 vary this by having Mateo write a rhythm for her, while s000017 moves the duet to a private setting. The repeated wording and closely related resolutions make the set highly similar; these sampled stories do not establish diversity across the full generator.
